observation.visible_scene: A glowing cyan Buddha head statue sits centered in the lower frame, framed by an arch-shaped opening in a large iridescent soap-film dome that fills the upper frame against a black background. The film shows shifting rainbow interference colors: a bright blue-green arc at the top, magenta/purple bands around the arch, and horizontal green-purple striped bands across the lower portion. A dark silhouette reflection of a person appears on the left side of the dome, and a dark vertical shape (finger or tool) appears on the right edge.
visible_changes: The horizontal green/purple interference stripes on the lower part of the film slowly drift and change spacing across the clip.
The magenta/purple blotches near the top of the dome deform and shift position gradually.
The dome's outer outline and the curvature of the top blue-green arc change subtly over time (slow deformation of the film surface).
The glowing Buddha head stays fixed in position, size, and appearance throughout.
The dark person-reflection on the left and the dark vertical shape on the right remain at essentially constant screen positions.
No pan, tilt, or zoom is evident; the framing of the Buddha head is unchanged, indicating a static camera.
outside_clip_unknowns: What causes the film's color bands to move (drainage, airflow, or an unseen touch is not shown).
Whether the dome is overall growing, shrinking, or being formed before or after this segment.
The origin of the Buddha head's glow and the lighting setup outside the frame.
uncertain_details: Identity of the dark vertical shape on the right (finger, tool, or reflection) is not clear.
Whether the dome outline changes reflect true deformation, slight translation, or only pattern motion on a stationary surface; the camera being perfectly static cannot be fully confirmed.
The motion is very slow and continuous; no discrete start/stop event is visible within the excerpt.
